info.title: Trading API
info.description: Every trading REST route, each once, as GET /api/v1/routes lists it. x-access says who may call it: public answers without a key, private needs a key or a session, internal is service to service only. x-scopes is every permission an API key needs. x-signed-out is the refusal a caller with no credential gets: its status, the body field and the code. x-only-with futures-matching marks a route mounted only while futures orders go through matching. x-cost is what one call takes from the rate-limit bucket. Amounts are decimal strings. No server is listed: the owner has not set the hosts (see /developers/hosts).
